description.desc_thousand_char: Kilitch Healthcare India Limited (KHIL) was formerly known as NBZ Pharma Limited. It is a pharmaceutical company. It offers services such as contract manufacturing, product licensing, product development and commercialization, and many more. The company offers sterile injectables in liquid and powder forms, ophthalmic formulations, nasal fromulation, PFS, and swabs–sticks. It is an ISO certified company. Its clientele includes Sandoz, FDC, Emcure, Merck, Ranbaxy, Unichem, and many more. The company was incorporated in 1998 and has its registered office located in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
